_provenance.what: Every BPHS chapter/verse citation in source/src, with the file and line it appears on and the claim it sits in.
_provenance.why: The project's rule is that a citation is either exact or absent. That has been kept by hand in prose across 38 files with nothing checking it: a wrong chapter, a volume that contradicts the same chapter cited elsewhere, or a verse range written backwards would all have shipped silently.
_provenance.derived: GENERATED FROM THE CODE, never edited by hand. The code stays the one place a citation is written; this is an index of it. A registry that had to be edited in step with the prose would just be a second thing to forget.
_provenance.whatThisCannotCheck: Whether a verse SAYS what the surrounding code claims. That needs the text as data, which is the next step. What it does check is the citation itself: chapter in range, volume self-consistent, verse range not backwards, notation uniform.
_provenance.edition: BPHS, R. Santhanam translation, 2 volumes, 97 chapters (the uploaded edition this project cites).
_provenance.volumeSplitSource: BPHS-Santhanam Vol. 1, preface: "The present volume—first volume—contains 45 chapters while the remaining 52 chapters have been put in the second volume." Vol. 2 opens at Chapter 46, "Dasas (Periods) of planets".
